title: A Light for Lowsong
description: The sixth light of the ring, on Lowsong rock in the Low Water, has been cold since the Snuffing. Its Keeper is alive. The fog out there sings.

stages.text: Lowsong's light wants a memory, like every beacon. But Brother Iver Lusk says the fog on the Low Water leaves nothing lying for anyone to find: three months and not a pebble, not a button. It only sings. He keeps one small lamp and sits out on the rock listening for the one voice he can nearly make out.

The fog on the Low Water gives nothing up, so Brother Iver made Lowsong's Remnant himself, with your ember beside him: something of his own, put down into a thing he was holding until the fog went hard round it. Carry it up to the cold cradle. Or give it back to him; it's still his until it burns.
